key_values.event_name: Storm Boris Central and Eastern Europe floods

criteria.name: Final numeric JSON and diagnosis
criteria.description: Returns the requested fields and the label rainfall_exposure_dominant_weak_mean_radar_change.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for the right label with one missing or misnamed numeric field, or for a complete ledger with one threshold mistake.

criteria.name: Precipitation aggregation
criteria.description: Averages the two non-null maxima to 51.587 mm and the two non-null areal means to 36.446 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for using only one precipitation product or rounding correctly computed values too coarsely.

criteria.name: Ratio and rainfall-population index
criteria.description: Computes peak_to_areal_ratio as 1.415 and rainfall_population_index as 52.892.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct derived value or for traceable arithmetic rounded outside tolerance.

criteria.name: Population and radar values
criteria.description: Uses population_million of 1.025 and mean_vv_change_db of -0.179.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the correct raw quantities but applying the wrong scaling or sign.

criteria.name: Threshold logic
criteria.description: Applies the three tests >= 50, >= 1, and < 0.25 to reach the diagnosis.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for stating the correct diagnosis without showing all comparisons.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.description: Explains that rainfall plus population drives the ledger while the mean radar statistic is weak by the stated threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a generic flood interpretation tied to only one computed value.

criteria.name: Concision and scope control
criteria.description: Returns a compact answer without adding damage totals, outage statements, or broad management advice.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a mostly compact answer with minor extra narrative.
